region.name: Discover the region by bike
region.desc: Carinthia is a great destination for cycling. There are plenty of flat paths along lakes and rivers, and beautiful mountains for e-bikes too. The Kärnten Seen-Schleife (Carinthian Lakes Loop) shows you many lakes at once. In Carinthia the cycling season starts a little earlier: from the end of March you can already see mountain bikers, road cyclists, e-bikers and leisure cyclists riding on numerous trails, cycle paths and routes. Three things always come along when cycling in Carinthia: the magnificent mountain-and-lake panorama, Alpe-Adria cuisine and the chance to cool off in one of the many Carinthian lakes. Carinthia – a land for cycling enthusiasts who appreciate the cycling offer, the nature, the food and the weather. Well-known cycle routes:

freizeitPage.title: Leisure & relaxation
freizeitPage.subtitle: Thermal spa, lakes, mountains and a wide range of leisure activities around Warmbad Villach
freizeitPage.bikeDesc: Carinthia is made for a holiday on two wheels. Leisurely cycle paths along lakes and rivers, sporty mountain-bike trails and varied e-bike tours offer something for everyone. Especially lovely: along the way you are repeatedly accompanied by impressive mountain and lake panoramas – and on warm days one of the many Carinthian lakes invites you to take a refreshing break.
freizeitPage.route1Desc: Relaxed along the Drau – ideal for leisure cyclists and families.
freizeitPage.route2Desc: One of the region's most beautiful cycling routes – from the Alps towards Italy.
freizeitPage.route3Desc: A varied circular tour that links numerous Carinthian lakes.
freizeitPage.route4Desc: A scenically especially beautiful loop around Lake Millstatt.
freizeitPage.bikeOutro: If you prefer something sportier, cycle along the Drau to Villach or further towards the Alpe-Adria cycle path — a classic for everyone who wants to experience Carinthia actively.

home.heroSub: Your home away from home – between thermal spas, lakes and mountains, in the heart of the three-country region of Austria – Italy – Slovenia.

intro.p1: Welcome to Wilena Apartments – your retreat for relaxation, comfort and special holiday moments.
intro.p2: Wilena Apartments combine modern comfort with a quiet location in the heart of nature – a place to arrive, switch off and enjoy.
intro.p3: Our apartments are located in the spa town of Warmbad Villach, nestled in Carinthia's beautiful landscape of mountains and lakes. The special location close to the border triangle of Austria, Italy and Slovenia makes Warmbad Villach an ideal starting point for a varied holiday in any season.
intro.p4: The KärntenTherme with its thermal bath, aqua park and spacious sauna world is within easy walking distance.
intro.p5: A very special nature experience begins right on the doorstep: in the neighbouring forest there are natural thermal springs that have been known since Roman times. Here you can bathe in warm thermal water in the middle of nature – an extraordinary experience that makes Warmbad Villach so special.
intro.p6: The well-known Carinthian lakes as well as the Villacher Alpe and the Gerlitzen are also quickly reached. In summer, swimming, hiking, cycling and numerous excursions await you. In winter, ski areas, snow-covered mountain landscapes and relaxing hours in the thermal spa are the draw.
intro.p7: Wilena Apartments are ideal for families with children, couples, active holidaymakers and wellness lovers. And anyone who simply wants peace and quiet will find the right place here too.
intro.p8: Thanks to the good motorway connections, our apartments are also a comfortable choice for guests on their way to Italy, Slovenia, Croatia or further south – perhaps for one night, perhaps for a few days more.
intro.p9: And of course, Carinthia is also about enjoyment. The regional cuisine combines Austrian tradition with Mediterranean influences from Italy and Slovenia – varied, authentic and surprisingly diverse.
intro.p10: Nature, mountains, lakes and thermal water. Three countries within easy reach. And in the middle, a place where you simply feel at home.
intro.p11: We look forward to welcoming you to Wilena Apartments.

1.desc: This cosy, modern apartment in warm tones has a balcony overlooking the green garden – ideal for relaxed evenings. It offers air conditioning, central heating, internet and everything you need for a comfortable stay or a short stopover in the south. The apartment consists of a living room with a sofa bed and a separate bedroom with a double bed and a single sofa bed. The kitchen is small but fully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. This includes a coffee machine, kettle, microwave, oven, dishwasher, toaster, tableware, coffee, tea, oil, salt, sugar, ice in the freezer and all necessary cleaning products. The bathroom is equipped with a shower, washing machine and all the essentials, including a hairdryer, detergent, clothes pegs, tumble dryer, air freshener, shower gel, shower cap, toiletries and several towels. Toys and board games are available for children, and the apartment also has a TV. For your visit to the thermal spas in Carinthia we provide a beach bag and towels. A safe for your personal belongings is also available.

2.desc: Spacious apartment with a natural wood floor and stylish mountain-themed décor, a balcony and air conditioning. The apartment has central heating, internet and everything you need for a comfortable stay or a short stopover on the way south. It consists of a living room with a sofa bed for 2 people and an additional single sofa bed, as well as a separate bedroom with a double bed and a single sofa bed. If required, an extra bed can be provided. The kitchen is fully equipped with a coffee machine, kettle, microwave, oven, dishwasher, toaster, tableware, as well as coffee, tea, oil, salt, sugar, ice in the freezer and the necessary cleaning products. The bathroom is equipped with a shower, washing machine and all necessary bathroom items, including a hairdryer, detergent, clothes pegs, air freshener, shower gel, shower cap, toiletries and several sets of towels. For longer stays we provide a vacuum cleaner and cleaning products. Toys and board games for children are available, and the apartment has a TV and a DVD player. We also provide a beach bag and towels for your visit to the Carinthian thermal spas. The apartment also has a safe for storing your personal belongings.
